notes.title: Bulken Update 1.46
notes.content:
[b]Alpha 1.46[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717620/caeae68bac610c01bc6c2aef918bfd1150afaa46.png[/img]

Updated project to Unreal Engine 5.5.1

Mechanical enemy types can no longer be 'stunned', but they can 'malfunction' from taking static damage.


[b]Updated enemy: Breacher[/b]
[list]
[*]Made new character art asset that can better express its protected state (+ its a cool robot!). 
[*]Updated sounds & portrait.
[*]Breacher is now 'mechanical' type
[*]Increased value of breacher, increased its HP, protection % amount & up time.
[*]Slowed and improved timing/telegraphing of its melee attack.
[*]Increased its minimum range for firing grenades & increased grenade AOE radius.
[*]Improved shooting AI, now determines the target spot earlier & added more warning time.
[/list]

Updated Workbench & Button art.

Added new skill to Scan tree: Scan Vulnerability. -Causes Vulnerable SE for the duration of the scan. Req is lvl 3 scan.

Added screens to all lower deck entry areas to show the local mutation or give boss warning.

Improved targeting system with charge weapons (railgun and flame thrower) and optimized the calculations.

Reduced minimum ground click radius on Player.

Fixed spoke level mutations not being activated on enemies.

[b]Updated and tightened enemy AI setups in general[/b]
[list]
[*]Better melee strike timings.
[*]Enemies using abilities now should have windows where they can chase/melee. (some enemies would never strike even if they could)
[*]Aligned movement animation rates to size variations of Araclings.

notes.title: Bulken Update 1.45
notes.content:
[b]Alpha 1.45[/b]


Added new upper deck type: "Mainframe" as a new HUB concept with "Sub Levels" as spokes.

Added in world panels to display global mutations associated with a sub level.

Player inventory now displays global mutations that affect all enemies in a deck.

Improved player inventory UI: Schematics now has a max of 2 rows visible with a scrollbox.

Improved floating text showing damage.

Added new status effect: Vulnerable. The target takes double damage while active. Enemies that channel abilities are Vulnerable for the duration.

Biomancer now teleports to a new location when getting below 50% HP the first time.

[b]Radar[/b]
[list]
[*]stand alone consoles that are hacked are marked with a highlighted round shape.	
[*]added exit POI to non-security check exits & updated icon for "security" exits (no longer recyclers)
[*]optimized process for making the POI's and added size variations.
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b] 
[list]
[*]Reduced hitpoints of all early (tier 1) units.
[*]Removed miniboss at the end of deck 20.
[*]Void Beast now has 10 armor (flat damage reduction)
[*]Shotgun no longer has kickback when fired but pushes enemies far back.
[*]Shotgun base damage increased.
[*]Plasma base damage decreased.
[*]Pistol ammo clip amount reduced.
[*]Tweaks to stun and push gameplay & stats all around.
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b] 
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where movement speed wasnt being reset correctly after breaking free from being stuck in goo.
[*]Fixed a bug where dash would get stuck on cooldown after skill upgrade.		
[*]Fixed an issue with XP: Was not handling overflow amount correctly from large amounts of XP incoming during level up.
[*Fixed clearing the Biomancers channel spell when it dies.
[*]Fixed a bug where flamethrowers didn't deal damage until enemy was immolating & improved shield interaction with flamethrowers.
[*]Fixed issue with rooms not using its designated spawn spots correctly for floor objects, which resulted in enemy spawns on top of healing pads etc.
[*]Fixed not returning to normal move speed when having reload cancelled.
[/list]

notes.title: Bulken Update 1.42
notes.content:
[b]Alpha 1.42[/b]


[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Master volume control to options menu.
[*]Updated background soundscapes & added custom reverb settings for rooms.
[*]Added lowpass sfx filter when player is wounded and/or affected by airlock.
[/list]

[b]Skill system[/b] 
[list]
[*]Expanded the skill "paths": Unlocks on the "main paths" branches out to new paths or discrete skills with synergistic abilities and stats.
[*]Some skill paths have been extended from 3 tiers to 5 tiers.
[*]Heavy weapon paths are now branches on other relevant main paths. ("Railgun" becomes available after "Nuclear 1" etc.).
[*]Schematics skills now becomes available as branches on relevant paths ("Metabolism" becomes available after "Viral 1" etc.).
[*]Schematic skills are now color coded based on type.
[*]Removed "random" schematic skills.
[*]Owned skills now show the stat & the combined sum of stats for all levels of that type + skill icon.
[*]Skills are rebalanced and tweaked in general.
[*] Removed some upgrades, converted some of them to skills.
[/list]

[b]Status Effects[/b] 
[list]
[*]Updated status effect system allowing for better rules, communication and synergies.
[*]Fire damage now causes "Immolation" (dealing 10 fire damage 3 times over 6 seconds)
		- The player must take 3 instances of fire damage within 10 seconds to immolate
[*]Viral damage now causes "Disease" (dealing 5 viral damage 10 times over 20 seconds)
		- The player must take 3 instances of viral damage within 10 seconds to get diseased
[*]Radioactive damage now causes "Weakness" (reduces all five resistance types by 25% for 10 seconds). 
[*]Status effects do not stack but additional instances during ongoing effects will reset its lifetime.
[*]Added status effect icons in the HUD above the hitpoint bar.
[/list] 

Added icons for item tooltips.

Added tooltips to explain damage types on the Character panel.

More robust handling of stacking movement modifiers.

Increased room light intensity in corner rooms

Fixed flame weapons no longer being blocked by broken debris from crates etc.

Secondary targets hit by penetrated shots (rail or uranium bullets) only take half damage (unless player has the "Breach" skill)

Updated floating text for better display + now indicates damage type, level-ups and status effects.

Performance optimizations.

notes.title: Bulken Update 1.40
notes.content:
[b]Alpha 1.40[/b]


[b]Improved midway boss fights[/b] (not the final boss)
[list]
[*]Added "stages" to the boss fights.
[*]Added new drone-themed boss.
[*]Updated/added abilities, special attacks & tweaked stats for bosses.
[*]Sentry guns are now always one-shotted by bosses.
[/list]

[b]Audio[/b] Soundscape experiments for rooms.

Made bullet impacts on metal more audible. 

Drones now have natural res (+25) vs static instead of viral (they still cannot get infected)

Fixed a bug where summoned units wouldn't chase the player correctly.

Fixed inconsistencies with level amount displayed in the HUD.

Changed XP numbers to display the sum of all gained XP / required XP (combined from all previous levels) to reach next level. 
(rather than just XP required from the current level to the next)

Fixed XP bar getting updated correctly on startup when entering a new level or reloading.

Improved static impact FX

[b]Added two new weapon upgrades to the sword[/b]
[list]
[*]Static upgrade changes the weapons damage type to static, increases damage by +20 and fires off a lightning strike on each hit.
[*]Sonic upgrade changes the weapons damage type to sonic, increases damage by +35 and hits in a larger cone.
[/list] 

Fixed bugged sound attenuation settings.

Reduced damage from fire on the ground from exploding enemies and now scales their duration with size of creature.

Improved floating text.

notes.title: Bulken Update 1.39
notes.content:
[b]Alpha 1.39[/b]

TLDR: Control experiments: early game pad support.

[b]Control options[/b]

[list]
[*]Added option to toggle between keyboard & gamepad controls. Note that toggle between control scheme wipes custom keys for now!
[*] Disclaimer: Gamepad is WIP - Menu and UI navigation still needs a lot of polish. It also might not work on all gamepad models!
[*]Gamepad controls have slightly different rules for how the aiming/targeting works that fits better with the scheme. This is still WIP.
[*]Removed some alternate key bind options and menu key bind. 
[*]Added keys for experimental WASD movement (on arrow keys by default) but for now its not fully supported.
[*]Fixed issues where custom keys would sometimes reset.	
[/list] 

[b]Additional Updates[/b]

Environment art updates: boss deck, exit areas.

Prologue Hangar: Extending catwalk and adding sounds.

Prologue Quarantine: Streamlined upgrade introduction with fixed upgrades, removed some enemies.

Added 1 additional row of inventory space.

Scrap max stack size increased to 16.

Skimmers added as enemies to crawl space decks.

Updated tooltips so the panel expands and title never breaks into the description text.

Improved the tooltip placement for item slots to avoid clipping outside of screen on loadout.

Updated skill descriptions: more details and stats and added decorator icons.

Xp balance: xp required for leveling up is now progressively being further increased to reduce over-leveling in late game.

Attempt to make mouse navigation more robust and avoid bad clicks.

Made the destination marker less jumpy when holding down the mouse to move near walls and obstacles.

notes.content:
Updated level select icons: the color of the mutation icons now reflect the resistance type.

Changed half of the mutations back to neutral types.

Deck20 now always have creeps as one of the two enemy types.

All decks now only have max 1 type of tier 2 & 1 type of tier 3 enemies.

Added new edge sections to Cargo decks.

Added light panels in rooms along the top edge to reinforce communication of the rooms state.

Fixed flashlight not toggling correctly in corner rooms and removed small flash when traversing between two lit rooms.

Increased Debris Pile hp and decreased Barrier hp (exploding mines can now one-shot a barrier)


Added new player mechanic: "Overload"

	[list]
[*]Overload (OL), when ready can be activated by pressing 'D'

[*]Overload gives a short (3 sec) time dilated window where the next action/attack is boosted.

[*]If no action is taken during the overload window its wasted until its replenished.

[*]All ranged weapons have custom OL attacks with more bullets, bigger attack areas or more damage etc.

[*]OL close combat attacks deal tripple damage.

[*]OL dash makes a longer dash and replenishes the next dash imidiately + deals an additional 50 damage when hitting enemies.

[*]Performing a task with OL, like hacking, sealing, repairing or reloading happens instantly.

[*]OL is replenished by killing enemies and performing tasks like repairing and sealing. Boosters also replenish OL by 20%

[*]Leveling up or hacking a room replenishes OL fully.

[*]OL replenishment is not displayed as a task icon but has its own new UI element in the HUDs bottom left corner.
[/list]

Completing tasks like sealing and repairing now gives +200 XP & +20% overload progress.

Added new unit: Skimmer

	[list]
[*]tier 1 (low level), flying, organic.

[*]moves fast and attacks in close combat.

[*]flees when taking damage from the player.

[*]finds the player and attacks after fleeing.

[*]has regeneration.
[/list]

Updated enemy icons, added missing ones.

Crafting that can use consumable items is now able to use items that are placed in the quick item slots.

notes.title: Bulken Update 1.36
notes.content:
Added shotgun as new heavy weapon.

Added shells item as ammo for shotgun.

The scatter bullets for the pistol now deal less damage at longer distances, similar to the shotgun.

Enemies can now attack physical barriers and debris piles.

Performance: optimized enemies poly count.

Abomination & Biomancer charge attacks now hits with damage types according to their mutation.

Improved the communication of enemy AOE charge attacks.

Character now moves to the exact spot the player clicks on. Before it would stop a bit early, making it hard to avoid AOE.

Fixed a bug where Drones would stay just outside of shooting range and not fire at the player.

Increased Drone shooting distance from 650 to 750.

Reworked loadouts. No more wrench item in the cheapest package.

Backfill enemies spawning are now the enemy types thats picked as regular mobs in the level. (Before it was always creeps.)

Fixed missing enemy spawns during exit fight on Crawl Space decks.

Improved player death sequence.

Moved backfill spawners in exit sections to avoid issues where corner sections would intersect.

Fixed calculation of barricades / debris pile occurrence relative to game progression.

Debris piles are now spawning more frequent on lower decks and at lower tier levels vs barricades.

Fixed collision settings on Crawl Space walls that could block player input.

When reaching the exit area of a lower deck, if current tracked objective is incomplete it gets notified in the HUD.

Heavy weapon upgrades does not appear until high level decks are reached.

Tweaked player strike impact sounds.

Reduced amount of enemies in early decks.

notes.title: Bulken Update
notes.content:
[u]TLDR: update to mutations, damage types & QOL[/u]

Upgraded to Unreal 5.3.2

Fixed key mapping issues related to new version of Unreal (still some kinks there with deprecated setups).

Crawl Space decks now only features Araclings / Eggs

Added "Aracling Nests" objectives for Crawl Space.

Fixed collision issue around nests that sometimes made units spawn inside walls or get stuck on the nest.

Updated Level Select UI and the special Mainframe UI (at the end of prologue) with better presentation.

Text in console logs is being typed out.

Added a randomly placed healing pad to all lower decks.

Reduced player default resistances from 10% to 0%.

Added 5 body upgrades that increase resistances by 40% for each type.

Added visual indicator (X) on creeps to communicate their state.

Fixed issue where too many different enemy types where used in a level.

Fixed conduits clearing their range indicators when solved.


[b]Mutations & Damage type:[/b]

	- Enemy mutations now sets the affected enemies damage type to the same as the resistance type of the mutation.

	- Updated some of the enemy attack FX to represent the damage types from mutations.

	- Renamed several mutations and updated descriptions.

	- Updated the mutation icons and tool tips with more clear descriptions, color coding, more stats and better layout. Fixed some number calculation issues.

	- floating text indicating damage taking on the player now tells the type of damage.

notes.title: Bulken Update
notes.content:
[u]TLDR: lower decks improvements & run randomization[/u]

Lower decks are now randomized in type/theme for each run (except for the midway boss fights)

Added new lower deck type: Crawl Space.

Reworked gameplay for Engine lower decks: The player now has to clear an amount of set waves to unlock the exit area.

Added more main section variations to all lower deck types.

Added new breakable prop: "Debris Pile". Similar to barricade but much fewer HPs.

Added an objective tracking system to the main HUD.

Now displays the global mutation for lower decks both on the splash and in the HUD.

Dashing into breakable props that doesnt normally take damage from player collision will now deal damage to the prop. 
	- Affects: barricades; creep nests; debris piles.

Added mutation icons to relevant UI and fixed resistance icons showing on their tooltips.

Added mutation icon (when applicable) and "failed attempts icons" to simplify the intro splash presentation.

Replaced the player death animation with ragdoll simulation.

Added body upgrade "Health Absorb" that heals the player with 15% of damage dealt in close combat.

Doubled clip sizes for pistols and smgs.

Increased costs for loadouts.
